'''Written Khilese''' was a script used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belnar/Legends|Belnar]] by the [[Khil]] [[Species/Legends|species]] to write their [[Khilese|language]]. The writing system was ornate and resembled poetic verse.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />
